name: click to action
author: Deepak Vishwakarma

sections.description:
The Floating Chat Widget plugin adds modern floating action buttons to your website, enabling users to quickly get in touch via various communication channels including phone, email, chat apps (WhatsApp, Telegram, WeChat, etc.), appointment booking, feedback, and more.

These buttons are highly customizable through the admin settings panel, where you can configure each button’s link. It’s an easy-to-use and highly effective way to improve customer engagement and support.

Features:
– Floating buttons with icons for WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS, Call, Email, Appointment, Help, and Feedback.
– Simple admin panel to configure button links.
– Easy to use and lightweight.
– Fully customizable via settings in the WordPress admin panel.
– Supports external and internal URLs.

Usage

After activating the plugin, go to the Floating Buttons settings page to configure the links for each action button:

  • Call Us: Set a phone number (e.g., tel:+1234567890).
  • Appointment: Set a link for appointment booking (e.g., https://example.com/appointment).
  • Email Us: Set an email link (e.g., mailto:example@example.com).
  • Chat: Set a WhatsApp or other chat service link (e.g., https://wa.me/1234567890).
  • Help: Set a help page link.
  • Feedback: Set a feedback form or page link.

Once set, floating action buttons will appear on the front-end of your site, allowing users to engage with your business.

License

This plugin is released under the GPL v2 or later. See the GPL-2.0 License for more details.

Support

If you face any issues or have questions, feel free to contact support via the plugin’s support page on WordPress.org or visit our website https://varanasiwebdesign.com/.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. In your WordPress admin panel, go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and select the downloaded .zip file.
  4. Click Install Now and then activate the plugin.
  5. Once activated, go to Floating Buttons in the WordPress admin menu to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
How do I customize the appearance of the floating buttons?

Currently, the appearance is controlled by the plugin’s CSS file. You can customize the appearance by editing the style.css file located in the plugin’s css/ directory.

Can I add more buttons?

Yes, you can add more buttons by extending the plugin code or by editing the fab_add_buttons function in the plugin. For advanced users, you may also add custom buttons in the admin settings page.

Do I need any additional plugins?

No, this plugin works independently and does not require any additional plugins.
